name: AX-cmd-03 CM-12 'Ares Heavy' Six-Seat Capsule -- modern interior (full)
frame: Godot Y-up, metres; same origin as the exterior GLB; node +Y = direction, node +Z = up

gravity.note: launch / entry: acceleration along +Y (stack axis); crew reclined in the seats (front row spine 55 deg, rear row 45 deg behind vertical); after splashdown 1 g toward -Y; on orbit zero-g

exterior_hide_note: none needed: the interior adds its own inner panes (window_glass stays; optional hide listed in the handoff iva.json)

hatch_door_1.note: outward-opening side hatch, hinge on the +X edge (outer face); rotate with the exterior mesh hatch_door_1 about node_hatch_door_1_hinge

hatch_door_2.note: docking hatch opens into the cabin, hinge on the CAD +Y edge of the tunnel

exterior.note: pressure_vessel liner (IML + 30 mm, m_seam) excluded: it is the vessel wall by definition (standard 3)

egress_paths.method: voxel widest path (4 cm grid) from each occupant's envelope volume into the hatch keep-out volume (side hatch: opening x 0.06-0.8 m inboard; docking: r<=0.45 from 0.35 m below to 0.05 m above the tunnel mouth); clear diameter = 2 x bottleneck clearance to the nearest item surface or IML; egress pose = moving parts at egress_folded

notes: hatch 1: coaming rim chamfer 8 mm on the convex cabin-side edges (greedy; 60 edges, 5.257 of 8.302 m incl. edges merged by neighbours; not chamfered: 5 short edges, 0.275 m)
